patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: My nose started bleeding an hour ago and I can't get it to quit. I've been pinching it. It's the front of my nose, dripping out the front — not down my throat.
clinical.presentationShort: 60yo M ? nosebleed for 1 hour, blood dripping from front rather than throat, slows with pressure; not anticoagulated, hemodynamically stable.
clinical.presentationLong: 60-year-old male with one hour of bleeding from the front of his nose. It slows with sustained pressure and is not running down his throat. He is not taking anticoagulants and remains hemodynamically stable.

diagnosis.disposition: Fast Track → firm pressure, oxymetazoline, cautery/packing if needed, control BP; discharge.
diagnosis.why: Anterior bleed dripping out the front → pressure, vasoconstrictor, cautery. Posterior (down the throat) is the scary one.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: seated, pinching the bridge of his nose with a tissue
signs: pinching his nose with a tissue
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a white 60-year-old man, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: pinching the bridge of his nose with a tissue, head slightly forward. Expression: annoyed but calm. Clearly visible: pinching the nose with a bloodied tissue. No text, no logos.
